---
title: "Roast Chicken Dinner"
---

## Summary

A full roast chicken dinner with fluffy potatoes, roast carrots and beetroot, crisp broccoli, and quick chicken gravy.

- **Prep time:** 30 minutes
- **Timer:** chicken roast time plus 20 minutes
- **Serves:** 2 adults and 1 child

## Ingredients

### Chicken

- [ ] 1 whole chicken, about 1.4 to 1.6 kg
- [ ] 1 chicken Oxo cube

### Potatoes and vegetables

- [ ] 500 g King Edward or Maris Piper potatoes, peeled and cut into roast-sized pieces
- [ ] 2 carrots, peeled and cut into batons
- [ ] 2 raw beetroot, peeled and cut into wedges
- [ ] 1 small head broccoli, cut into florets
- [ ] 1 1/2 tablespoons duck fat or oil for the potatoes
- [ ] 2 teaspoons oil for the carrots and beetroot
- [ ] 2 teaspoons oil for the broccoli
- [ ] Salt and black pepper

### Gravy

- [ ] Bisto Best chicken gravy granules
- [ ] Kettle-boiled water

## Method

- [ ] Heat the oven to 180°C.
- [ ] Crumble the chicken Oxo cube and rub it all over the chicken skin.
- [ ] Put the chicken into a roasting tray on the middle shelf.
- [ ] Work out the chicken roast time from the packet or from its weight, then set one timer for that roast time plus 20 minutes.
- [ ] Before T-50, prepare the vegetables: peel and cut the potatoes, carrots, and beetroot, and cut the broccoli into florets.
- [ ] At T-(total timer minus 30 minutes), check the chicken and spoon some of the roasting juices over the skin to baste it.
- [ ] At T-50, bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and parboil the potatoes for 8 minutes.
- [ ] At T-50, in a separate pan, parboil the carrots and beetroot together for 8 minutes.
- [ ] At T-42, drain everything well. Return the potatoes to the empty pan with the duck fat or oil, then shake the pan to rough up the edges. Coat the carrots and beetroot with 2 teaspoons of oil and season with salt and black pepper.
- [ ] At T-40, baste the chicken again, then spread the potatoes on a roasting tray and roast them for 40 minutes, turning halfway through.
- [ ] At T-40, put the carrots and beetroot into the oven to roast for 40 minutes, turning halfway through.
- [ ] At T-20, check that the chicken is cooked through, then lift it out of the tray and leave it to rest on a wire rack while everything else keeps cooking.
- [ ] At T-15, coat the broccoli with the remaining oil, season lightly with salt and black pepper, and roast it for 15 minutes.
- [ ] At T-5, boil the kettle and make the Bisto Best chicken gravy according to the packet.
- [ ] Carve the chicken and serve with the roast potatoes, carrots, beetroot, broccoli, and gravy.

## Serving note

If the chicken is larger or smaller than expected, adjust the total timer so it still includes 20 minutes at the end for resting while the vegetables and gravy finish. This amount should feed 2 adults and 1 child comfortably, with the chance of a little leftover chicken.
